thread:
Lina: noticed 'v2-preview' pill in tenant UI for acme, but router logs show ~60% v1 traffic.
Rohan: console reads admin flag; router uses client handshake header. expected mismatch during staged rollouts.
Maeve: This confuses customers and support. We should surface both values in the console and telemetry.
eng-telemetry: Proposal: emit disp_ver, obs_ver, route_sig. route_sig = HMAC_SHA256(header_ver||route_id||first8(tok_hash)) truncated to 12 hex chars.
Rohan: Important: billing must read from router billing tag, not display flag. add header X-Billed-Version for downstream billing to rely on.
ops-bot: Security checklist: any token-derived field must be irreversible and reviewed by eng-security.
Maeve: Sampling plan: 0.5% global, 5% for tenants in active rollouts. Add metric routing_display_mismatch_pct.
Lina: UX: show two small pills in tenant row: Display: v2 | Live: v1 with tooltip "Display = admin flag; Live = observed client handshake".
Rohan: Also implement a "display-only" rollout mode where display flips but billing stays on billed_version. Document behavior in RFC.
eng-telemetry: Add alert rule: if mismatch >20% for 15m per tenant -> P2 to #eng-oncall.
ConsoleBot: Task PLAT-1501 created for console UI.
Lina: I'll open telemetry PR with example KQL and sampling knobs.
Maeve: I'll draft UI copy and loop legal for the tooltip.
Rohan: I'll handle router change and billing header.
Lina: Thanks, team. Closing loop.
